title: Pizza
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

    all purpose flour

    yeast

    water

    salt

    olive oil

    pizza sauce

    cheese
    how to prepare:
    In a bowl add some all purpose flour, melted yeast, salt, and knead this mixture well and keep aside for 4 hours
    after 4 hours knead the dough again and roll into a pizza shape and add pizza sauce and italian seasoning, and cheese, apply some olive oil
    preheat the oven 475 farenheit, then keep the pizza inside the oven for 20 minutes and pizza is ready.
